summary: Templates from playbooks, roles, variable files and most built-in inventory plugins are trusted automatically, but custom plugins that source template strings must use new public APIs to apply trust.
questions: Do my playbook and role templates still render after the trust change?
What do I need to change in a custom inventory plugin for template trust?
Which sources are trusted for templating in ansible-core 2.19?

answer_card.title: Which templates are trusted automatically
answer_card.answer_md:
Backward-compatible trust is applied automatically in most cases. Templates in **playbooks, roles, variable files and most built-in inventory plugins** produce trusted template strings.

**Custom plugins** that source template strings must use the new public APIs to apply trust where appropriate. See the plugin API and untrusted templates documentation.
